kotaFacultyTricks.title: First 20 Seconds
kotaFacultyTricks.content: Identify whether the question is primarily testing nature and propagation of light or reflection from plane and spherical mirrors before writing equations.

kotaFacultyTricks.title: Exam Strategy
kotaFacultyTricks.content: Write the governing relation first, preserve the symbolic form, and apply restrictions before substitution.

kotaFacultyTricks.title: Final Check
kotaFacultyTricks.content: Use a quick sign, unit, limiting-case, or structural check before marking the answer.
